Alert.trigger: 3-month rainfall below 75% of the 1991-2020 normal, OR seasonal outlook probability of a driest-third season of 50% or more

actions.action: Share this draft with the County Steering Group and compare it with the latest NDMA drought early warning bulletin before any decision
Run a rapid functionality check of boreholes, water pans and earth dams in the county
Schedule repairs of broken water points and desilting of water pans while there is still lead time
Alert livestock officers to monitor pasture, water distances and livestock body condition for early decline
Check whether early action protocol triggers (e.g. Kenya Red Cross drought EAP) are close to being met and confirm readiness

Alarm.trigger: 3-month rainfall below 50% of normal, OR two consecutive assessed windows below 75% of normal

actions.action: Request NDMA confirmation of the county phase and activate the county drought contingency plan through official channels
Prepare water trucking and water-point repair for areas with the longest walking distances to water
Prepare cash support for the most affected households so they can buy water when vendor prices rise
Ask the county health department to scale up nutrition screening of children and pregnant or breastfeeding women
Coordinate with livestock officers on timely offtake and feed or water support before animals lose condition
Publish an approved advisory in English and Swahili through county radio and chiefs' barazas

Watch.trigger: Forecast 3-day rainfall total in the next 7 days above the county's 99th-percentile 3-day total

actions.action: Check the latest Kenya Meteorological Department warnings; they take priority over this tool
Send early warning messages to communities living along seasonal rivers (laggas) and in low-lying areas
Confirm the location and readiness of pre-positioned relief items (shelter kits, water treatment, hygiene kits)
Inspect and clear drainage channels and culverts on key roads
Alert the county health department to prepare for waterborne disease after flooding, including cholera

Warning.trigger: Observed 3-day rainfall above the 99th percentile in the last 3 days AND more heavy rain forecast

actions.action: Escalate to the County Disaster Management Committee and align with KMD and Kenya Red Cross updates
Prepare evacuation of households in flood-prone areas to identified safe sites
Distribute water treatment and hygiene supplies to displaced households
Map cut-off roads and bridges to plan how relief will reach isolated areas
Increase disease surveillance and readiness for cholera cases in affected areas

Watch.trigger: 3 or more forecast days in the next 7 with apparent maximum temperature above the county's 95th percentile

actions.action: Issue public heat advice: drink water, avoid midday sun, check on older people and young children
Alert health facilities to expect heat-related illness and confirm cooling and rehydration supplies
Advise schools to shift outdoor activities away from the hottest hours and ensure drinking water
Advise employers and outdoor workers, including herders, to schedule heavy work for cooler hours
Check that water points can cope with higher demand from people and livestock

Warning.trigger: 5 or more forecast days in the next 7 above the county's 95th percentile

actions.action: Activate pre-agreed heat actions with the county health department; link the warning to specific responsibilities
Prioritise outreach to older people, young children, people with chronic illness and outdoor workers
Ensure cooling in health facilities and schools where possible
Track heat-related illness reports during the event to judge whether actions are working
If drought is also at Alert or Alarm, treat water supply as the top priority for people and livestock
